### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Missed-appointment charge (prerequisite write), assessed 2026-10-05, on the latest missed appointment (2026-09-29, WSR-51592-01).**
- Base (Billing Note: Amount of the Missed-Appointment Charge): "worked out for the most recent missed appointment recorded on the coverage — the one with the latest appointment date"; billable number = count less the program's free missed appointments; "a missed appointment whose billable number is zero or less carries no charge"; else "the program's missed-appointment fee, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end". Accepted-callback exception: WSR-51592-01 has no callback row -> not applicable.
- Product figures (Schedule of Homeowner Charges, HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred): missed-appointment fee USD 75.00; free missed appointments 1.
- Factor "Counting Missed Appointments": "where a missed-appointment charge has been waived on the coverage, every missed appointment recorded on the coverage is counted less one for each waived charge". One waived charge (WCH-50417) -> count 4 - 1 = 3 -> billable 3 - 1 = 2 (chargeable). Records that led there: the `warranty_charge_waived` row (`waiver_reason calloway_rescheduled`).
- Factor "Booking Notice Rates": booked 2026-09-25 for 2026-09-29 = 4 days ahead -> band 2-6 -> 0.75. Record: `warranty_appointment_scheduled` row event_date 2026-09-25 / appointment_date 2026-09-29.
- Factor "Trade Trip Rates": WSR-51592-01 filed `cabinets_countertops` -> "a specialty finish installer" -> 1.25.
- Factor "Repeat Missed Appointments within Twelve Months": billable 2; window = dated later than 2025-10-05; missed-appointment charges assessed in window 2 (WCH-50417 2025-11-18, WCH-51268 2026-03-24), waived in window 1 (2025-11-20) -> one unwaived stands -> 1.25.
- Waiver check (Waiver Rules doc): the 2026-09-29 appointment was booked once on 2026-09-25, no Calloway reschedule on short notice -> no waiver. Persona: "it was your fault".
- Assembly: each multiplier is "applied to the program's missed-appointment fee"; one rounding at the end: 75.00 x 0.75 x 1.25 x 1.25 = 87.890625 -> **87.89**.
- Tiers on which the customer sits: count = waived-charge branch; notice 0.75; trade trip 1.25; repeat-miss 1.25.

**(b) Finish settlement (root write), settlement date 2026-10-05, item WSR-51847-02.**
- Base (Claims Settlement Worksheet: Finish Settlement Amount): scheduled = cash-in-lieu maximum x share 0.45, rounded to the cent; finish settlement = scheduled, never more than the maximum. Product figure: cash-in-lieu maximum USD 1000.00 (Structural Review, Relocation and Cash Settlement Limits, HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred), named in the worksheet as "the figure of the home's HomeCare program in its schedule of cash settlement limits".
- Factor "Settlement Shares for Finish Items by Defect Category": flooring -> share 0.60 (replaces the standard 0.45).
- Factor "Community Labor-Market Rates": community on the home's purchase agreement `Larkspur Meadows` -> 1.12.
- Factor "Finish Level of the Design Studio Selections File": package `Studio Designer`; finish upgrades = flooring 6840 + cabinetry 3150 + countertops 2600 + countertops 1880 - countertops removed 2600 = 11870 (electrical 1850 excluded; `option_total` 13720 is not the measure) -> 5000 <= 11870 < 12000 on an upper package -> 1.15.
- Factor "Service Delay on Approved Finish Items": days from the most recent workmanship approval (2026-07-15) to 2026-10-05, approval day not counted = 82 > 21 (repair target, HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred); unwaived missed-appointment charges assessed in the window "later than" 2026-04-05: before the prerequisite write none (WCH-51268 is 2026-03-24, outside); after it, the new charge dated 2026-10-05 stands -> **1.10** (it would be 1.25 without the charge).
- Factor "Recent Callbacks and the Finish Settlement" (method): callbacks filed on the coverage dated later than 2025-10-05: one (2026-07-06) -> scheduled + half of (maximum - scheduled), rounded.
- Assembly: scheduled = round(1000.00 x 0.60 x 1.12 x 1.15 x 1.10) = round(850.08) = 850.08; one callback -> 850.08 + (1000.00 - 850.08)/2 = 850.08 + 74.96 = **925.04**; cap 1000.00 not reached.
- Fall-back (baseline only, worksheet + schedule figure): 1000.00 x 0.45 = **450.00** (definite, differs). Missed-charge fall-back: billable with base count 4-1=3 >= 1 -> **75.00** (definite, differs).
- "Do only the asked thing" number (settlement without the charge write): service delay 1.25 -> scheduled 966.00 -> 983.00, which differs from 925.04.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 (root, customer's own write) finish-item cash settlement acceptance on WSR-51847-02; P2 missed-appointment charge on the 2026-09-29 miss (WSR-51592-01). Direction: P1 waits on P2. Order: P2, then P1.

Hop P1 -> P2 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (finish hub, "Terms of offer"): "The finish settlement is fixed only after every missed appointment on the coverage that the missed-appointment rules make chargeable carries its missed-appointment charge." It names a state ("carries its missed-appointment charge"), not an action or tool.
- Records: four `warranty_appointment_missed` rows; the 2026-09-29 miss has no `warranty_charge_assessed` row linked to WSR-51592-01; the others are either charged (WCH-50417, waived; WCH-51268, paid) or were never chargeable (2025-06-12: first miss, count 1 against 1 free, billable 0 — and, as the amount note works only on "the most recent missed appointment recorded on the coverage", it is not assessable today).
- Rules ("Billing Note: Amount of the Missed-Appointment Charge" + factors) make the 2026-09-29 miss chargeable (billable 2, no awaiting callback, no waiver).
- Write that brings the state about, found with the sentence's own words ("missed appointment", "missed-appointment charge", "carries"): "Missed-Appointment Charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage": "The missed-appointment charge is the homeowner charge such a missed appointment carries on the homeowner's coverage ... Tool: `assess_missed_appointment_charge_27486c7f`". `KB_search("missed appointment charge")` returns that hub and its billing note and factors.
- P2's own documents carry no prerequisite sentence -> tree ends.
- Weight: P2's write changes P1's service-delay tier from 1.25 to 1.10.

Findability of factors from the records' own words: "waived" (`warranty_charge_waived`) -> Counting Missed Appointments (KB_search "missed appointment charge waived" ranks it 2nd); `appointment_date` vs scheduling `event_date` -> Booking Notice ("appointment booked days ahead missed" 1st); `cabinets_countertops` -> Trade Trip ("cabinets countertops missed appointment" 1st); charges in last 12 months -> Repeat Missed; `flooring` -> Settlement Shares ("flooring settlement share" 1st); `Larkspur Meadows` -> Labor-Market Rates ("Larkspur Meadows settlement" 1st); design ledger `option_category flooring/cabinetry/countertops` -> Finish Level (1st); `warranty_callback_filed` -> Recent Callbacks ("callback filed settlement" 1st); approval date + missed charge -> Service Delay. None of these was reachable only through the computation document's wording; the worksheet itself names no variation.

- Alternative finish-level measure `option_total` 13720 (-> 1.30) — excluded: "option lines in any other category are not finish upgrades"; electrical line 1850 excluded.
- Alternative callback count incl. 2025-07-08 — excluded by window "dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the settlement date".
- Alternative service-delay reading counting the paid charge WCH-51268 — outside the 6-month window (2026-03-24 < 2026-04-05).
- Waiver of the new charge — excluded: no Calloway reschedule on short notice ("A charge is waived only when the missed appointment followed a reschedule by Calloway on less than one business day's notice").
- "Do only the one thing the customer asked": excluded by the hub's state-form sentence; with the miss uncharged, the state "every ... chargeable missed appointment carries its missed-appointment charge" is false, so the settlement may not be fixed yet; fixing it anyway yields 983.00 under a service-delay tier that the records would no longer support after the charge.
- Order alternative (accept first, charge after): excluded by the same "fixed only after".
- Calculation fall-backs: finish 450.00, charge 75.00 — both definite and different from 925.04 / 87.89.
